findings.title: Google Analytics and Tawk.to load on public pages with no cookie-consent or opt-out gate
evidence: apps/web/app/(public)/layout.tsx:58-78 injects the GA gtag script and the Tawk.to embed unconditionally when the IDs are set (afterInteractive, nonce only)
apps/web/app/(public)/privacy/page.tsx:56-64 discloses Google Analytics and Tawk.to as processors
git grep for consent components found only the contact/intake form checkboxes (apps/web/components/marketing/ContactForm.tsx:313) — no cookie banner or consent-mode gate
findings.impact: Analytics and live-chat third parties receive identifiers and set cookies before any consent, which is not defensible under GDPR/ePrivacy in the EU/UK and is inconsistent with the policy's 'cookies' disclosure.
findings.recommendation: Gate GA/Tawk behind a consent manager (or use Google Consent Mode v2 with analytics_storage denied by default), record consent, and add a visible opt-out; document subprocessors and DPAs.
